author: Ohio Statewide Staff
title: Most schools in Maryland to close next week - NewsBreak
text:
By Ohio Statewide Staff ,
5 hours ago MARYLAND — Most schools across Maryland will be closed Monday, May 25, 2026, in observance of Memorial Day, the federal holiday honoring U.S. military personnel who died while serving in the armed forces.
Public school systems throughout Maryland traditionally cancel classes for the holiday each year, while some districts are already nearing the end of the academic year or beginning summer break. Districts still in session are expected to suspend classes for the day.
Memorial Day is observed annually on the last Monday in May and is recognized nationwide as a federal holiday. Along with schools, many government offices, banks and businesses are also expected to close or operate on reduced schedules.
Communities across Maryland are expected to hold Memorial Day ceremonies, parades and other events throughout the holiday weekend to honor fallen service members. Increased travel is also anticipated as residents take advantage of the long weekend.
Classes are expected to resume Tuesday, May 26, for school districts that remain in session following the holiday.
